name: Distance
overview: Scripture teaches that maintaining spiritual and relational integrity requires discernment in the company we keep and the distance we place from ungodliness, as seen in Psalms 1:1 and Ephesians 5:11. When conflict arises, Matthew 18:15 encourages believers to address issues directly and privately to restore fellowship, underscoring the importance of close, loving relationships even across distance. Galatians 5:14 reminds us that love for our neighbor fulfills God's law, which applies to all relationships, including those separated by physical distance. Finally, Revelation 3:11 exhorts believers to hold fast to their faith with vigilance, guarding what is precious despite challenges that distance may bring.
